problem_type: Error codes whose wording only holds before submission leak out of the post-submission retrieval path, and the renderer does not recognize retrieval-stage codes
symptom: After a paid task was submitted, a query / download failure can be shown as 'this generation was never sent ... generate again' (outbound-blocked-submit, asset-upload-failed), and the renderer classifies retrieval-query as unknown with the hint 'retry once or switch model' and primary action retry, i.e. regenerate and pay again.
direct_cause: taskResultQuery.retrievalStageError passes any already-coded error through unchanged; vendorHttp's outbound guard tags every refused vendor request (including task queries) as outbound-blocked-submit and copies the refusal into structured.upstreamMsg; classifyGenerationError has no branch for retrieval-* codes.
class_root: Nothing records which task phase each NomiErrorCode speaks for; producers shared by submission and retrieval cannot know the phase, and neither the retrieval exit nor the single renderer classifier enforces phase-correct wording.
affected_population: Any async generation whose status query or result download is refused locally (fake-ip proxy, private address, credential-origin binding) or hits a pre-submit-coded failure
Every fetchTaskResult caller: canvas polling and retrieve-again, MCP read_task, Agent, production run reconciliation, model try, certification
Renderer surfaces that read classifyGenerationError for retrieval failures (Agent panel failure text, storyboard copy, error cards)
entry_points: vendorHttp.requestJson outbound guard (authorizeSubmitDestination) used by both submission and query requests
classifyGenerationError used by NodeRecoverableReport, NodeErrorReport, storyboard failure copy, Agent lane failure text, task telemetry
internal_only_reason: The phase semantics of Nomi's own error codes and the recoverable-retrieval flow are internal contracts; no external document decides them.
invariants: Every NomiErrorCode declares whether its wording only holds before submission (NOMI_ERROR_ONLY_BEFORE_SUBMIT is an exhaustive Record).

No error leaving fetchTaskResult carries a submit-phase code; submit-phase codes are re-tagged with the retrieval stage code, keep the original code and a 'blocked locally by Nomi' label in the technical text, and never carry Nomi's own refusal as provider text.
classifyGenerationError maps every retrieval-* code to retrieval-incomplete whose actions never include retry (regenerate).

door_reduction.why_not: Three different owners: the code table declares the phase, the main-process retrieval exit enforces it for every fetchTaskResult caller, and the renderer's single classifier turns retrieval codes into a non-retry action. Each sits on a different process boundary and cannot be merged. recoverTaskActions.reopenRecoverableNode is the error card's way back to the recoverable panel for canvas tasks (coordinator 10-22), next to the existing dismissRecoverableNode; it only flips a node with a taskId back to recoverable.

generality_proof: Every retrieval-path failure reaches users only through fetchTaskResult (20 callers, door-map) and is interpreted only by classifyGenerationError. fetchTaskResult now routes every thrown error through retrievalStageError, which consults the exhaustive phase table, so any present or future producer of a submit-phase code (vendorHttp guard, asset localization, new codes) is re-tagged without the producer knowing the phase; the classifier maps all retrieval-* codes to a kind whose action table has no retry.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Exhaustive declaration of which task phase each error code speaks for.
Single retrieval-stage error exit (fetchTaskResult routes every thrown error through it); passes through only non-submit codes and re-tags submit-phase codes.
Single renderer classifier; retrieval-* codes map to retrieval-incomplete (view-task, no retry).

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Its outbound guard tags query refusals as outbound-blocked-submit; retrievalStagePhase.test.ts drives that exact shape through fetchTaskResult and asserts the re-tag.
MCP read_task wraps fetchTaskResult errors with the raw message; retrievalStagePhase.test.ts asserts the message no longer carries the pre-submit claim.
Query failures already land recoverable regardless of code; recoverTaskActions.projectIdentity.test.ts pins it with a pre-submit-coded failure.
Poll failures are wrapped into RecoverableTimeoutError whatever their code; catalogTaskActions.test.ts pins one submission and a recoverable outcome for pre-submit-coded poll failures.

recurrence.reason: Any producer shared between submission and retrieval (vendorHttp guard, asset localization, future codes) can emit submit-phase wording during retrieval, and every retrieval failure reaches users through the same exit and classifier.
same_class_scan: node scripts/door-map.mjs retrievalStageError -> taskResultQuery.ts (6 call sites)
node scripts/door-map.mjs fetchTaskResult -> 20 callers across canvas, MCP, Agent, production run, model try, certification
rg outbound-blocked-submit -> networkOutboundMessage.ts / vendorOutboundGuard.ts, used by vendorHttp.requestJson for every vendor request including task queries
classifyGenerationError probe: retrieval-query -> unknown + retry before the fix

prevention.invariant: Errors leaving the retrieval path never carry submit-phase codes, and retrieval codes never classify to a retry action.
prevention.failure_mode: Submit-phase codes are re-tagged to the retrieval stage code with the original code kept in the technical text; uncoded errors are tagged with the stage code.
prevention.strategy: Exhaustive phase table consulted by the single retrieval exit, plus a dedicated classifier branch for retrieval codes.

legacy_paths.rationale: The pass-through rule is replaced in place by the phase-table rule; no parallel path remains.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party dependency controls Nomi's error code phases.

migration: No persisted state changes. Node errors already stored with retrieval-* codes are reclassified by the renderer on read (retrieval-incomplete) with no data migration.
residual_risks: Producers still do not know the phase (vendorHttp tags query refusals as submit); the retrieval exit corrects the code, but the specific network hint of the refusal (host / address) is reduced to the diagnostic prefix in the technical text.

Main-process 'failed' results for paid tasks (model unresolvable, no query operation) still render as ordinary failures; they are deliberate honest-failure decisions from #1213 and out of this change.
